from.place: proof, the free term in the minimal presentation has vanishing positive Tor

title: Positive Tor vanishes for a free module
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, let P be a free R-module, let M be an R-module, and let i>0. Then Tor_i^R(P,M)=0, with Tor as in [def-weil-pbc-tor-modules].

source.place: Algebra, Section Tag 00LY: compute Tor from the length-zero free resolution of a free module

mathlib_searches.query: positive Tor of a free module vanishes
mathlib_searches.verdict: match: free modules are projective, and the declaration gives vanishing in every positive degree

mathlib_match.how: specializes in one line: with Tor^R_i(P,M) := ((CategoryTheory.Tor' (ModuleCat R) i).obj P).obj M as in [def-weil-pbc-tor-modules] (left-derived in the first variable), the lemma gives IsZero for i=n+1 when P is projective in ModuleCat R; a free R-module is projective. (The worker's Rep.isZero_Tor_succ_of_projective is about Rep k G, and CategoryTheory.isZero_Tor_succ_of_projective at line 56 needs the second variable projective; corrected by reviewer R-mpt.)
